hypothesis.for_segment: Freelancer / small service owner in professional services (1-20 employees)
hypothesis.problem: Overdue invoices are followed up manually and too late because owners avoid awkward collection messages.
hypothesis.value_proposition: Turn overdue invoices into a daily action queue with clear follow-up playbooks so owners recover cash faster without awkward manual chasing.

in_scope: Manual/CSV overdue-invoice intake (invoice id, amount, due date, customer response status)
Daily prioritized follow-up queue by aging bucket and invoice value
Rule-based playbooks for two paths: late-but-responsive vs. ghosting
Copy-ready reminder templates with manual send workflow
Pilot landing/waitlist flow for intent capture
Lightweight outcomes log (replies, promised payment date, recovered amount)
out_of_scope: Automated email/SMS sending infrastructure and deliverability optimization
Native accounting integrations (QuickBooks/Xero) and two-way sync
Payment processing, collections/legal workflow, and dispute handling
Multi-team role/permission system and enterprise admin features
Mobile apps and multilingual product surface

test_design_14d.experiment: Run a concierge pilot with target operators using real overdue invoices, then measure qualified intent and paid conversion within 14 days.
test_design_14d.channel: Freelancer and small-business communities + direct outreach to users discussing overdue invoices
test_design_14d.offer: 14-day pilot: daily follow-up queue + reminder playbook; early adopters get discounted first month after pilot.

pricing_hypothesis.plan_b: $79/month — up to 200 active invoices + custom escalation rules

success_metric.target: Within 14 days: >=6 qualified pilot signups from 20 target users and >=2 paid starts (or signed paid-start commitments).

kill_criteria: By day 7, fewer than 4 qualified conversations from first 20 outreach attempts.
By day 14, fewer than 3 pilot signups or <10% visitor-to-qualified-intent rate.
Zero paid starts (or paid-start commitments) after pilot walkthroughs.
Median manual onboarding effort >45 minutes/account across first 5 pilot users.

marketing.headline_seed: Recover overdue invoices without awkward chasing
marketing.problem_story: Small service operators lose cashflow because invoice follow-up is manual, inconsistent, and emotionally hard; late reminders turn into long receivables.

manual_steps: Collect overdue invoice data via spreadsheet template and normalize fields.
Tag each account into response-state buckets (responsive/ghosting/disputed).
Generate daily follow-up queue and review with operator.
Approve/send template-based reminders manually and log outcomes.
Capture willingness-to-pay, objections, and recovery outcomes weekly.
automation_candidates: Automated invoice-data ingestion and field validation.
Automated priority scoring and next-best-action suggestions.
One-click outbound messaging with deliverability safeguards.
Recovery outcome dashboard with cycle-time and amount tracking.
